attributes.action: pubs and restaurants to provide 0% beer or lager on draft where practical
attributes.additional_details:
Where a premises offers multiple beer or larger Where technically and commercially feasible,  draft beer systems must provide at least one alcohol-free beer or lager on draft. If draft provision is not feasible, premises must be able to demonstrate reasonable efforts to comply.
Compliance with these requirements should be a condition of premises licensing, subject to inspection by local licensing authorities and actioned if these are not met
attributes.background:
Require licensed pubs and restaurants to provide alcohol-free beer or larger where a premises offers multiple beer or lager products, 
Where technically and commercially feasible, premises with draft beer systems must provide at least one alcohol-free beer or lager on draft.

rejection.details:
We can only accept petitions about things the Government or Parliament are directly responsible for.

Decisions about what drinks to serve are a matter for businesses, not the UK Government or Parliament.
